semantic_atoms.what_it_does: Defines four distinct recursion levels: deterministic data recursion, recursive model calls, recursive full harnesses, and GRID-controlled adaptive routing.
RealtimeSession carries a mutable Claude session reference and an optional room session identifier across a live conversation.
Realtime function calls preserve provider call_id through pending-tool dispatch and function_call_output re-entry.
Presence-derived causal_event_id can be propagated into initiative episode logging and voice outcome events.
The examined live Realtime module contains no agent_id, parent_agent_id, task_id, recursive_call_id, or generation fields required by the new full-harness recursion contract.
VoiceSessionCapsule identity_version fingerprints the voice persona/configuration and references UnifiedDB state; it is not an actor/parent/task/recursive-call lineage mechanism.

architecture_delta.before: GRID/design already had bounded recursive-harness research, while current Frankenstein donor exposed session/tool/causal identities without a complete recursive actor lineage.
architecture_delta.after: The design successor explicitly promotes R0/R1/R2/R3 adaptive recursion as a target primitive, but forensic donor evidence shows R2/R3 must remain source-level SPEC until stable actor/task/parent/recursive-call/generation plus effect/result lineage are implemented and tested.
architecture_delta.fusion_law: CHILD_RESULTS_ARE_CANDIDATES; preserve evidence provenance, correlated derivation, contradiction, negative results and unresolved alternatives; majority does not mint truth.

hypothesis.claim: Adaptive GRID routing across deterministic computation, model recursion and full-harness recursion can outperform one fixed recursion strategy on mixed workloads.
hypothesis.falsifier: A matched-model fixed-budget mixed benchmark shows routing overhead and state duplication eliminate score/verifier gains or materially increase coordination failures versus a simpler fixed harness.

counterhypothesis: A single strong harness with simple bounded spawning will be cheaper and more reliable because adaptive routing overhead plus duplicated state management offsets specialization gains.
next_exact_gate: Before any R2/R3 whole-system runtime claim, add/test stable child actor/task/parent/recursive-call/generation identity and bind every child tool/effect/result receipt to that lineage; then run the preregistered mixed-workload RLM-only vs RAH-only vs GRID-adaptive ablation.
